purpose: Bring your export: map a GDOT AASHTOWare Safety (GEARS) crash export to CrashIQ's crash keys. Column names are AASHTOWare's, as published in ARC's open layers built from GDOT's export (Crashes 2020-2024; MARTACountyCrashes_2023) and on the GDOT-523 form.

crash.sec_distance: GDOT-523 'Not At Its Intersection But ___ Miles/Feet' (not in the ARC layers; ask GDOT to include it)
crash.weather: not in the ARC layers; GDOT-523 has Weather
crash.is_freeway: Functional Class (Crash Level) = Interstate / Other Freeway & Expressway; or 'Interstate' flag

severity.severity_note: KABCO as GDOT gives it; 'Unknown' (1.0% in 2020-2024) is U, injury level not reported.

person: Person-level KABCO needs GDOT's person table (Injury Status in MARTACountyCrashes_2023 is per person); ask GDOT to include it.
